calls.title: Brick: literary non-fiction window (essays, reviews, interviews)
calls.pay: CAD $65-$720 plus two copies and a one-year subscription
calls.details: Finished, polished work only, via Submittable; free-submission cap often fills early; replies can take up to a year. Next window Apr 1-30, 2027.

calls.title: AGNI: fall reading period (includes review essays)
calls.pay: $30 per printed page for prose (reviews included), up to $300, plus a one-year subscription
calls.details: Deadline 11:59pm ET. $3 fee per online submission (waiver on request). Reopens Jan 15 - May 31, 2027. Review essays 1,500-3,000 words via the review-specific page.

calls.title: Still Point: poetry-book reviews (March issue)
calls.details: Complete, copyedited review of a recent poetry collection, 750-1,500 words, by email.

calls.title: The Wire: New Voices competition for emerging music critics
calls.pay: Winner: £250, publication in the March 2027 issue and a digital subscription; free to enter
calls.details: Send a 500-word review (recent album, book, festival, gig, film or exhibition in The Wire's territory) plus a 500-word opinion piece on 'Music criticism is irrelevant in contemporary culture'. For writers with no more than three paid music pieces published. One entry each, attachments only (.doc/.rtf/.pdf), no AI. Closes midnight GMT.

calls.title: The Threepenny Review: reading period (critical articles)
calls.pay: $400 per article; $200 per Table Talk piece
calls.details: Critical articles about 1,200-2,500 words on books, films, theater, art: each review should read as an essay broader than its occasion. Online or mailed submissions only, never email. Closed Apr 15-Dec 31.

calls.title: The Common: expanded book-review section wants reviewers
calls.details: Reviews of place-centred books from small independent presses released within the last three months; no self-published books. Pitch a review or propose a book via the form on the page.

calls.title: Drafting the Past: history book reviews (pitching Dec 2026 / Jan 2027 titles)
calls.pay: $200 per single-book review; more for review essays
calls.details: Nonfiction history only. Pitch at least three months before publication; as of its latest note it is taking pitches for books out in December 2026/January 2027 or later. Up to 1,000 words (essays up to 1,500).

calls.title: Grain: call for pitches for short book reviews
calls.details: 450-word book reviews (also 900-word interviews and craft essays). Email pitch, 250-word outline max; rolling.

calls.title: Ancillary Review of Books: calls for reviews & essays, January 2027 titles
calls.details: Speculative fiction, cultural studies and related nonfiction; the call lists January 2027 titles and also invites series, re-reads and 'Ancillary Guides'. Pitch via the form after reading the style guide. (December 2026 list also still up.)

calls.title: The Markaz Review: MIS/TRANSLATION themed issue (essays, translator's notes, reviews)
calls.pay: Honorarium paid within 30 days of publication (NBCC sheet lists $120)
calls.details: Works in translation and essays about the craft of translation, mistranslation, and translator's notes via Duosuma. Regular weekly book review pitches remain open year-round.
